questions.title: How will export keep using one saved revision?
questions.agreed: Export a saved document without changing it.
questions.needs: The mechanism is recorded; implementation remains outstanding.
questions.why: A document edited during export must not produce a mixture of revisions.
questions.nextStep: Build the recorded mechanism and test concurrent edits.

questions.title: Who will settle how long generated files remain?
questions.agreed: The requester receives a generated file.
questions.needs: Coordinate generated-file retention with the document owner.
questions.why: Keeping every old export would retain more copies than intended.
questions.nextStep: Find the document owner and record the retention agreement.

questions.title: What should be offered when export fails?
questions.agreed: Show the failure and leave the saved document unchanged.
questions.needs: Choose retry alone or retry plus an explicitly older successful file.
questions.why: An immediate older file is useful but could be mistaken for the latest revision.
questions.nextStep: Choose the failure experience after reviewing the two investigated possibilities.

candidates.title: Offer retry
candidates.consequence: Rerun export; no older file is offered.
candidates.feasibility: Fictional Research establishes rerunning the saved revision as feasible.
candidates.tradeoffs: Less retained output, but no immediate file after failure.

candidates.title: Offer retry and last successful file
candidates.consequence: Make an explicitly older revision available immediately.
candidates.feasibility: Fictional Research establishes retained output plus its revision label as feasible.
candidates.tradeoffs: Immediate fallback requires more retained output and clear age labeling.
